title: Fire Ants Build Living Rafts That Float for Months

scenes.text: Fire ants build living rafts that float for months.
When a flood hits, thousands of ants grab each other with their jaws and legs.
One lab raft held about twelve thousand ants.
Their bodies trap a layer of air, so the ants on the bottom don't drown.
Push the raft under, and it bobs back to the surface.
An insect that turns itself into a boat.

description:
Fire ants link their bodies into floating rafts that can stay afloat for months.
A trapped layer of air keeps the bottom ants breathing, and the raft bobs back up if pushed under.
Would you trust an ant boat?
first_comment: Would you trust an ant boat in a flood?
